$comment: Measured-velocity ramp of the per-tick output acceptance (Task 10).
The measured position stays at 0.05 rad; the measured velocity steps through
0.00 .. 0.30 rad/s every 4 ms, below the configured velocity limit and small
enough that a joint sample is never a discontinuity. Every control tick of a
50 Hz command window therefore sees a different measured velocity, which is
what makes the per-tick torque recomputation observable.
Entries cover 4.5 s, longer than any acceptance window of the scenarios.
